selected.reason: Slot competitive debut and Salah opening-weekend scoring record begin title season.
Decisive early rivalry victory and third successive clean-sheet league win under Slot.
Twice recovering against eventual runners-up preserves early title-race position.
Significant European victory over holders with Kelleher penalty save during flawless league-phase start.
Win over champions establishes nine-point league lead and 11-point margin over City.
Exceptional nine-goal match confirms Christmas leadership and Salah attacking contribution.
Nunez stoppage-time double turns threatened third consecutive league draw into vital win.
Fourth-round elimination by struggling Championship opposition interrupts four-competition campaign.

Final defeat leaves Premier League as remaining route to silverware.

omissions: Most league fixtures are omitted. The Forest defeat, Southampton comeback, Newcastle/Fulham draws and late-season results can supply dated campaign context without one article per weekend.
Leverkusen win and other league-phase victories are context for finishing top of the Champions League standings; Madrid and both PSG legs preserve the distinct European story.
Tottenham League Cup semi-final comeback is evidence for the route to Wembley, covered within the final report rather than a separate commission.
Arsenal home draw after clinching and defeats to Chelsea/Brighton are included in final-season context where necessary, not treated as a new title race.
limitations: Distinguish 27 April title clinch at 82 points from 25 May trophy presentation and final 84 points.
The 1 December advantage was nine points over Arsenal/Chelsea and 11 over Manchester City; February 23 was 11 over Arsenal with unequal games played.

Salah final totals are 29 league goals and 18 assists: 47 combined, equalling the overall Premier League record and exceeding previous 38-match-season totals. Do not describe 47 as an outright all-era record.
Goodison must be described as the final men’s senior derby there, avoiding unsupported assertions about future women’s fixtures or closure of the stadium.
Disciplinary incidents after Goodison final whistle require the official FA decision if included, not speculation from match reaction.
EFL final page retrieved only title/navigation; it is not relied upon for action, goals or detailed milestone claims. Opponent Newcastle report retrieved as corroboration.
Both PSG legs merit reports for different reasons: extraordinary goalkeeper performance and late winner in Paris, then the defining shootout elimination at Anfield.
The user-defined endpoint is 2024–25; do not import later careers, transfers, deaths or subsequent season results into these match reports without necessity and evidence.
Full line-ups, exact times, detailed action and contextual claims need independent cross-checks during manuscript production. No footage reviewed.
No manuscript may begin until the coordinator confirms remote claims and chronological previous-season checkpoint.
